answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 120 identities means 120 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the signal pair is tracked in the velvet ledger, the whisper audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward demands answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 24%. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
